name: one-oven
description: Deterministic multi-dish kitchen scheduling over MCP

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @one-oven/contracts && npm run build --workspace @one-oven/server && npm run build --workspace @one-oven/agent && npm run build --workspace @one-oven/voice && npm run build --workspace @one-oven/scenarios && npm run build --workspace @one-oven/simulator
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @one-oven/server && npm run test --workspace @one-oven/agent && npm run test --workspace @one-oven/voice && npm run test --workspace @one-oven/scenarios && npm run test --workspace @one-oven/simulator
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate:recipes && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run e2e:text && npm run e2e:scenarios
scripts.voice:check: npm run voice:roundtrip && npm run voice:demo -- --scenario weekday-3 --speed 60
